answer: New identities climb a verification spiral from zero. First, publish a work sample anchored to its key, checked against earlier samples. Second, pass a live working session with a random peer. Third, lock a 600-unit bond for 60 days. Fourth, pass an unannounced onyx-sealed audit of the full log. Weight unlocks only after rung three. Per fake: one genuine sample, two live operator-hours, 600 units locked two months; 100 fakes: 60,000 units locked, 200 hours. Each rung needs a different proof, so no one script climbs it, and a bought pre-climbed identity restarts at the bottom.
